name: Harrypam
body:
"The next time I read a blog, Hopefully it won't disappoint me just as much as this particular one. I mean, I know it was my choice to read, however I truly thought you'd have something useful to talk about. All I hear is a bunch of moaning about something you could possibly fix if you were not too busy looking for attention."
